data.summary: The review profile is highly anomalous. A 12-year-old pool company with only one perfect review across all platforms is extremely unlikely. The lack of any substantive customer feedback, positive or negative, suggests the business either does minimal public-facing work, has actively suppressed reviews, or the online presence is not representative. The perfect rating is not credible.
fake_signals: Extremely low review volume for business age
No reviews found on major contractor platforms (Angi, Houzz)
No customer feedback on BBB profile
No negative or neutral reviews present
authentic_signals: BBB profile shows 12 years in business
data.discrepancy_explanation: A perfect 5.0 Google rating with only 1 review is highly suspicious for a 12-year-old business. The BBB A+ rating is based on accreditation/compliance, not customer feedback, and has no reviews or complaint data. The lack of reviews on any other platform (Angi, Houzz, Yelp) is a major red flag.
